nom: Benefit Cosmetics The POREfessional Shrink Wrap Overnight AHA+PHA Pore Treatment

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report no irritation or redness, though one needed to limit use to once a week to avoid her skin getting red.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report reduced texture and smaller-looking pores with regular use.
segments.combination: One reviewer with normal-to-combination skin and enlarged pores reports brighter, more even-toned skin with fewer fine lines.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry skin reports no irritation or excess dryness from the treatment.

concerns.spots: A few reviewers say the treatment also faded dark spots and post-blemish marks alongside minimizing pores.
concerns.blemishes: Some reviewers report fewer new pimples or less inflamed acne with regular use, describing it as part of an acne-control routine.
concerns.aging: A few reviewers, including one in her 40s, describe smoother fine lines and firmer-feeling skin alongside the pore-minimizing effect.
concerns.redness: The product tingles on application for many without causing redness, though one reviewer with sensitive skin reports her skin got red when using it twice a week and had to cut back to once a week.

aspects.libelle: Results fade, pores return to normal size
Needs about 30 minutes to dry before bed

extraits.titre: Good, but be careful if you have sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I have normal to dry sensitive skin. I do not suffer from any acne, but I do have issues with my pores. They're not huge but they're there. After using this product for two weeks, I didn't notice a positive change, but I can only use it once a week once I tried two times a week and it's cost me to get red. I would recommend this product for people that have not too sensitive skin gifted by benefit

This product is really interesting, but I like it. It does work to shrink pores, but I can't say that it's long lasting. Pores will be smaller in the morning but return to normal size. As someone who has very large pores, I'm always looking for products to shrink them. I just wish I could find something permanent. Pros: faint to no scent, nice texture, a little goes a long way.

extraits.titre: Love how it makes my skin look and feel
extraits.texte: Wow, this product is amazing! I noticed a difference after just one use. I've only been using one pump for my face and that has been enough. I've tried applying it by itself and also on top of moisturizer, and I think I like it best when used alone. It dries fairly quickly, tightens, and tingles ever so slightly - in a good way. In the morning, my skin looks brighter, pores definitely look smaller, and my skin feels slightly firmer. It's also incredibly smooth. After using this product the first time, I did notice a very small amount of skin flaking after a couple days, so I've only been using it one or two nights a week. I did not expect to like this product as much as I do. I'm 45, and even though this treatment is marketed to shrink pores, I feel that it's just a great anti-aging product all around. I will definitely continue using this because I love the way my skin looks and feels after using it. Gifted by benefitcosmetics in exchange for my honest review.

I really love all the new skincare products benefit has been coming out with. I love how innovative this product is. I like that I can layer it over my own moisturizer. After use I feel that my skin looks more tightened yet plump. I am new to acids so I am taking the journey slow but excited to see long term results. The texture feels nice on the skin. I do wish the time needed to wait before going to bed after application was shorter. The bottle and ingredients are high quality. I like that it's not greasy feeling on my skin which is already oily and sensitive and I haven't had any issues with irritation. Gifted by benefitcosmetics for my honest review.

Gifted by Benefit cosmetics The Pore Fessional Shrink Wrap I'm always in search of a product that will help decrease the size of my pores on my t zone. This is an overnight pore treatment with AHA (lactic and glycolic acid), PHA (polyhydroxy acid gluconolacctone) and niacinamide. What do these do for your skin? Well, they help to tight pores & re-texturize your skin leaving your face looking brighter overall. This can be used up to three times a week. You apply 2-3 pumps evenly over your face in the very last step of your skincare routine. Let dry for 30mins and then head your way bed! It's that easy. My thoughts: I used this a handful of times since receiving it. I find it odd that it used in the last step of your routine but I don't make the rules. I did notice a difference in the appearance of my larger pores on my nose area. Do I think the product "shrinks them"? No, I do think that the ingredients helped to decongest my pores leaving them to appear smaller. I love the niacinamide in the product, it does leave a noticeable glow. The texture reminds me a lot of retinol just slightly thinner. There is no scent to the product which I always appreciate. I will only use this once a week as I already use other chemical exfoliants. Using this as my last step does seem to leave my face moisturized for longer. I do already use some products with AHA but I like this one better because I feel like the concentration of it is higher and I can physically see the results.

This works so well and flawlessly shrinks my pores or well cleans them out overnight. I like to use this when I have a special event the next day I don't find this irritates my skin or overly dries it out and I do have dry skin. I highly recommend this, gifted by benefit
